item.description: Blender is the fastest tool to edit videos, especially if your editing requires a lot of cutting and moving strips. item.title: A Journey through PAPERWORLD
item.description: Take a quiet tour around a wonderful world with Viral Chaudhari's Paperworld. A project to emulate paper craft virtually in 3D. I wanted the train to run naturally. In spite of animating the whole train, I went through some physics simulation test on train to run on tracks. It worked well. Rendered through Cycles Engine. [...] Source

item.title: Create Stylized Pine Trees Using Blender 5 new Array Modifiers and Grease Pencil
item.description: Thanks to Blender 5.0's new Array Modifier, Dad's Castle shares a different approach to creating stylized pine trees using grease pencil brushes and the free “Grease Pencil to Curves” Blender extension. It’s easy to do, requiring no artistic skills in grease pencil. Enjoy and have a great day! Source
